title: Project Forge-5
description: Command five specialized robots through indoor qualification missions and an outdoor physics sandbox.

prompt.objective: Build a five-robot simulator with missions and outdoor freeplay.

mintAssets.brief: Five industrial robots: humanoid, quadruped, tracked, wheeled, and aerial.
Industrial qualification facility with navigation lanes and task zones.
Obstacles, fixtures, cargo, tools, and outdoor physics props.

experience: Select a robot and room, then drive, jump, manipulate props, and complete missions.
Use outdoor freeplay for switching, pickup, placement, throwing, and flight.
prompt.visualDirection: Dark industrial UI with cyan telemetry, condensed type, and safety cues.
